The '''Striped gizka sculptures''' were a set of seven sculptures of a rare striped [[Gizka/Legends|gizka]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gorbus]] came to own six of them and paid double what the seventh statue was worth in order to complete the set.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Completing the Collection}}</ref>
